name: Loose Change
description: A handful of coins — mostly pennies, a few dimes, one quarter that's been in your pocket long enough to feel like it belongs there. Adds up to something. Not much.

name: Bus Token
description: A Tri-Met bus token. Good for one ride anywhere the 4 or the 6 will take you. Which is not Kenton — not directly. But it's a way out if you need one. You keep it in your pocket like a promise.

name: Karaoke Cassette
description: A cassette tape of you singing at the Blue Parrot. Five dollars you will never get back. The sound quality is what you'd expect from a tape recorder mounted above a karaoke machine in a dive bar in 2001. You sound terrible. This is a document.

name: Food Pantry Bag
description: A brown paper bag from Abundant Life Church. Canned beans, canned corn, a box of mac and cheese, and a granola bar. They didn't make you sit through anything. They just handed it to you and said God bless.
